name: vibe-puzzles
description: Daily logic puzzles in the browser: Pinwheel, Tetroid, Sudoku, Calcudoku and Loop. Generated puzzles with consistent difficulty levels, step-by-step hints, tutorials and offline play as a PWA. Built with SvelteKit, Svelte 5 and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers.

paragraphs: A collection of logic puzzles that runs in the browser, in English and German. Every puzzle has a unique solution; puzzles are generated on the device or taken from a pre-generated collection.
Built with SvelteKit 3, Svelte 5, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4. The optional server runs on Cloudflare Workers with D1.
features: Tetroid: shade one tetromino in every region so that all shaded cells connect, no 2×2 block is shaded and equal tetrominoes never touch.
Pinwheel: divide the grid into regions with one circle each, every region point-symmetric around its circle.
Sudoku: fill the 9×9 grid so that every row, column and 3×3 box holds the digits 1 to 9 once.
Calcudoku, a mode of Sudoku: 5×5, 7×7 or 9×9 without boxes; every row and column holds each digit once, and the digits of each cage give its target with its operation (+, −, ×, ÷).
